description: Travaux d'assainissement is a dataset listed in Grand Paris Grand Est open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Grand Paris Grand Est. Données des travaux d'assainissement en cours, passés et à venir, engagés par Grand Paris Grand Est. Les travaux ont pour objectif de réduire la pollution rejetée dans la Marne et / ou d’entretenir le réseau existant. Coverage: Grand Paris Grand Est. The portal files it under Sanitation. The portal shows 162 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-02-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-gpge-portal.
